test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which of the following years was the Dowry Prohibition Act passed in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1961.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Dowry Prohibition Act was enacted on July 1, 1961:

 
 
• Its purpose was to prevent the giving and receiving of dowry.
 
• According to the Dowry Prohibition Act, "dowry" means any property or valuable security given or agreed to be given directly or indirectly.
 
• The Dowry Prohibition Act is applicable to persons of all religions in India.
 
• Punishment for violation o**f law is 5 years imprisonment and Rs 15000/- or the value of dowry whichever is higher. **
